annotation.title_clean: PL 2338/2023 - Dispõe sobre o desenvolvimento, o fomento e o uso ético e responsável da inteligência artificial com base na centralidade da pessoa humana
annotation.title_en: Bill 2338/2023 - On the ethical and responsible development, promotion and use of artificial intelligence centred on the human person
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Brazil); bill authored by Senado Federal - Rodrigo Pacheco
annotation.summary_en: Chamber of Deputies tracking page for Brazil's AI bill PL 2338/2023 (from the Senate), awaiting the rapporteur's opinion in a Special Committee. It lists about 37 attached AI-related bills, covering synthetic-content labelling, copyright, education, health, liability and algorithmic bias. The page gives metadata only, not the bill text.
key_provisions_or_claims: Bill sets ethical and responsible AI development and use centred on the human person
Amends the National Digital Education Policy (Law 14.533/2023) and the FNDCT funding law
Status: awaiting rapporteur's opinion in a Special Committee of the Chamber
37 related bills attached, on labelling of AI content, copyright, liability, health and bias audits
Includes provisions on self-regulation, penalties, competent authority and worker protection
